choices.text:
The loop at lines 9–12 follows `default_table` pointers without rechecking that each new `j` is within bounds (the check at line 6 only applies to the initial state). A differential state whose parent is itself, or a cycle among differential states, causes an infinite loop; a parent value that is itself out of range is never validated. The bug is introduced by following the parent without rechecking it.

Answer: 11
